name: crypto-education-thailand
description: My Capstone Project is a website designed to teach teenagers the basics of cryptocurrency in a simple and safe way. The website will include short lessons written in easy-to-understand language, with a quiz after each section to check understanding. It will also feature interactive tools such as a glossary and a chatbot to help explain key terms. The project is aimed at teens who are new to cryptocurrency and want a clear introduction without being overwhelmed.
